strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Allows an existing headless.continue_once recovery-run continuation to supply one explicit diagnostic-guided context read and finish the recovery task under Rust runtime authority.
Carries one M31.1 bounded context-read authorization into the targeted recovery task run without requiring an external caller to read raw files.
Keeps progress freshness, recovery run target, current provenance, ReadWorkspace permission, path safety, and context-read authorization validation in the Rust runtime.
Records a headless continuation decision with metadata-only context-read hashes and identifiers while preserving replay without duplicating evidence or exposing raw content.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting context_management, runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and controlled_workspace_tools.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can run one targeted verification recovery task while also authorizing one bounded diagnostic-guided recovery context read for that task.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M31.1 lets task.run read diagnostic-guided context, and earlier M18/M30 phases let headless continuation run/admit recovery tasks, but the headless recovery-run continuation cannot pass the read authorization through the runtime-owned route.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: A headless caller can choose a recovery task to run but still cannot complete the context-dependent recovery step through one replay-safe continuation decision.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M30.1 produced bounded diagnostics, M31.1 materialized task.run context reads, and M31 closeout only selected this next capability; this phase connects those capabilities through the existing headless continuation route.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. It extends existing headless.continue_once params/results and delegates to existing task.run; no new report, history, digest, readiness, preview, or inspection endpoint is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. Existing TaskRunResult verification_recovery_context_read summary is reused; the headless decision event records only bounded metadata.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime validates the recovery run target and context-read authorization, executes task.run with that read, records bounded continuation metadata, and replays the same result without rereading or duplicate events.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless automation can move from fresh progress evidence to a diagnostic-context-informed recovery proposal without external raw file reads or manual task.run orchestration.
answers.milestone_progress: This is the core M32 vertical slice and should make M32 closeout-eligible once CI and review confirm the continuation is end-to-end and replay-safe.

review_value_gate.review_intent: M32.1 must be reviewed for actual headless continuation behavior that executes one targeted recovery task with one authorized diagnostic-guided context read and preserves metadata-only replay.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts verification_recovery_context_read only with a valid verification_recovery_run_target and explicit authorization.
The runtime rejects context-read continuation requests that are not paired with the targeted verification recovery run path or that combine unrelated recovery/apply/retry/provider fields.
The targeted recovery task is executed through existing task.run with one M31.1 verification_recovery_context_read request, producing a recovery proposal with bounded context metadata.

HeadlessContinuationDecisionRecorded includes only replay-safe context-read metadata and hashes, with no raw excerpt, file content, prompt, stdout, stderr, command, environment, absolute path, canonical path, or secret.
Replay of a continuation_id returns the same bounded task_run_result and does not duplicate TaskRunning, VerificationRecoveryContextReadMaterialized, terminal task evidence, or decision events.
VSIX protocol validation accepts valid headless continuation params containing verification_recovery_context_read and rejects raw content/path/prompt fields or invalid authorization.
No new RPC, report, digest, history, readiness, preview, capability, or inspection wrapper is added.
